name: sdd-harness
description: Agent harness — a stack-agnostic spec-driven pipeline (spec → plan → implement → QA → publish), plus a verification harness for perceptual work, packaged as reusable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Spec-driven development pipeline: orchestrator + planner/executor/critic/tester/publisher/archivist agents, TDD implement loop, doc-audit, and PR workflow. Stack-agnostic via .claude/sdd/config.json.

plugins.name: render
plugins.description: Verification harness for perceptual work: capture endpoint, named observation set, numeric proxies, symptom-keyed traps. For domains where a failure is something you see rather than something that throws.

plugins.name: ci-runner
plugins.description: Run a repository's GitHub Actions jobs on your own Linux or macOS machine: a self-hosted runner installed as a service, and one command to turn it on or off with automatic fallback to GitHub-hosted runners.
